contribution_types.description: Gamification: Avoid all mentions finance related terminology so as not to fall under securities regulation. Stay strictly as a game. Basically remove God Mode Totally from the Game

Gamification: As you level up, your portion of winnings generated via overall tokens staked on you increases. This should include tokens staked from your supporters. This encourages you to continue maintaining great performance
Market Sizing: There are only around 1,000 professional quants out there in the market. The size of that market is not really large. But the size of analyst is much larger
Building a fund on crypto allows you to bring in a lot of followers to your fund to make a lot of money without the need for license

Easiest way to bring alot of followers to your platform is to promote that you will help them earn money. However this is restricted in various jurisdiction. In countries where crypto is not considered a financial asset, then advice given on crypto is not considered financial advice

Easiest way to bring even more followers to the platform is to implement a referral program to have influencers bring their followers to the platform

- 50% of the revenue shared to investors
- 25% of the revenue shared to fund manager
- 25% of the revenue shared to influencer who brought in investor

Analyst are B2B providers. Traders are the people who take the analysis and executes the trades. These are two very different profiles

Analyst make money selling insights
Traders make money by buying insights to execute as trades
Each fund will utilize multiple different trading strategies
The fund manager allocates funds between winning and losing strategies

Recruit analysts separately by enticing them with the opportunity to make money from the followers on our platform. 

By removing the conflation on our landing page website caused by targeting our messaging to two different audiences our conversion rates on our landing page will become higher. 

In a nutshell have two separate landing pages with two separate marketing campaigns

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nOj1_IidRMY&t=8s
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kNrp0ETJsPE&t=2s

UX needs to be simple. Knowing how to create a crypto wallet is considered the biggest achievement in most people's life

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nOj1_IidRMY&t=8s
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kNrp0ETJsPE&t=2s

MagicSquare is 100% token. The way voting right of fiat investors who invested during the private rounds are based on lockup and vesting. 

https://magicsquare.gitbook.io/magic-square-litepaper/sqr-token/distribution-and-allocation

MagicSquare is bumping up the valuation of the SQR tokens even before they are available on the exchange by buying back the offchain tokens using USDT and locking them up for a year using the revenue they are generating from advertising revenue
On NFT design: Propose to sell tokens/shares/bonds instead

Andrey Nayman responded with some key insights about the Latokens exchange 

Waiting for further inputs from him on the approach me and @41799155602 discussed which we plan to experiment with through the course of this year.

Time spent by him to respond 30 minutes ‎<This message was edited>

Just finished 30 minutes FaceTime with @41799155602 and Andrey Nayman to talk about collaborations and other matters

narrative.text: Andrey Nayman contributed to Agroverse and TrueSight DAO over two years, from April 2022 to February 2024, with 18 entries primarily in Build Game - Strategy activities. He provided reference materials and links five times, reviewed proposed strategies with clear improvements three times, and reiterated pending decision signals independently three times. Andrey also suggested cautions or areas to watch twice, contributed educational reference materials twice, logged two hours of human effort, and offered one actionable step in a strategy review.
